none.notes: Plain kernel build with no root manager source integration.

kernelsu.notes: Official KernelSU. SUSFS is disabled because current official refs do not accept the upstream generic SUSFS manager patch.

kernelsu-next.notes: Official dev branch for non-SUSFS builds. SUSFS builds use pershoot/KernelSU-Next@dev-susfs, a fork branch based on official dev with SUSFS integration.

apk_build.notes: Pushes to dev upload a production-signed 'manager' artifact. Not used for SUSFS builds: pershoot's fork commits have no official-signed app.

sukisu-ultra.notes: Official main branch without SUSFS; official builtin branch is selected automatically when SUSFS is enabled.

bakasu.notes: Official main branch includes manager-side SUSFS support.

apk_build.notes: Pushes to main build a production-signed Manager-release artifact (PR builds use a throwaway key).
